blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Cybercrime Investigation and Coordinating Center (CICC) on Wednesday allowed online platforms Reddit and Discord to establish a presence in the country beyond the initial 24-hour deadline in a bid to strengthen cooperation. The move follows the CICC’s earlier directive to the two platforms to set up offices in the country as part of its efforts to strengthen cooperation amid concerns about rising school violence linked to online groomers.
